info.title: Daintree Decisions relay protocol
info.description: Normative semantics are in docs/protocol.md. Protocol version 1. Every authenticated request carries "Authorization: Decisions-Sig v=1,i=<installation>,d=<device>,t=<epoch ms>,n=<nonce>,s=<ECDSA P-256 signature>" over the canonical request (method, path, sorted query, SHA-256 of the body, device, installation, timestamp, nonce).
